```{r setup, include=F}
library(tidyverse)
```

```{r read data}
source("../R/main-data.R")
source("../R/helpers.R")
```

```{r get biotypes}
biotype = read_tsv("../data/gencode.v45_gene_biotypes.tsv") %>%
  group_by(Gene) %>%
  summarise(
    biotype = case_when(
      any(biotype == "protein_coding") ~ "protein_coding",
      any(biotype == "lncRNA") ~ "lncRNA",
      any(grepl("pseudogene", biotype)) ~ "pseudogene",
      any(grepl("^(rRNA|Mt_rRNA)$", biotype)) ~ "rRNA",
      any(grepl(
        "^(miRNA|snRNA|snoRNA|scaRNA|scRNA|sRNA|misc_RNA|vault_RNA|ribozyme)$",
        biotype
      )) ~ "small_RNA",
      any(grepl("^(IG_|TR_)", biotype)) ~ "IG/TR",
      TRUE ~ "other"
    ),
    .groups = "drop"
  )

unique(biotype$biotype)
```

```{r check tc data}
results = data.frame()

for(nm in c("tc_dea", "ikba_dea", "primary_dea")){
  
  df = get(nm) %>% 
    filter(sig != "ns", treatment %in% c("GC", "Bud", "Dex")) %>% 
    pull(Gene) %>% 
    unique() %>%
    as.data.frame(nm = "Gene") %>%
    left_join(biotype, by = "Gene") %>%
    count(biotype) %>%
    na.omit() %>%
    mutate(dataset = nm, .before = 1) %>%
    mutate(total = sum(n)) %>%
    mutate(frac = n/total)
  
  results = rbind(results, df)
  
  rm(nm, df)
}

ggplot(
  results,
  aes(x = dataset, y = frac, fill = biotype, group = biotype)
) +
  geom_col(position = position_dodge(width = 0.9)) +
  geom_text(
    aes(label = n),
    position = position_dodge(width = 0.9),
    vjust = -0.3
  )

lncrnas_detected = data.frame()

for(nm in c("tc_dea", "ikba_dea", "primary_dea")){
  
  df = get(nm) %>% 
    filter(sig != "ns", treatment == "IL1B") %>% 
    pull(Gene) %>% 
    unique() %>%
    as.data.frame(nm = "Gene") %>%
    left_join(biotype, by = "Gene") %>%
    filter(biotype == "lncRNA") %>%
    mutate(dataset = nm, .before = 1)
  
  lncrnas_detected = rbind(lncrnas_detected, df)
  
  rm(nm, df)
}

lncrnas_detected %>% pull(Gene) %>% unique()

```
